title: Senior Technician, Facilities Mechanical
description:
Job ID

JR115995

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

### **Operations & Preventive Maintenance**

* Perform routine operation and maintenance activities for mechanical facility systems and equipment.
* Carry out and physically verify scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) activities.
* Support SAP PM activities, including work order updates, maintenance records, and timely closure of assigned activities.
* Perform daily equipment and utility checks, record operating parameters, and identify abnormal conditions.
* Attend equipment breakdowns promptly, troubleshoot faults, identify root causes, and support restoration of equipment.
* Conduct equipment checkouts after maintenance to confirm proper system operation.
* Prepare and maintain preventive maintenance records, equipment checklists, service reports, and other required documentation.
* Maintain appropriate spare-parts and consumables inventory for mechanical maintenance activities.

### **HVAC & Mechanical Systems**

* Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and support repair of: Chillers and chilled-water systems HVAC systems Air-conditioning and ventilation systems Air compressors and compressed-air systems Vacuum systems Water systems Pumps and associated mechanical equipment Fire hydrant/mechanical fire protection systems Cleanroom HVAC and related mechanical systems
* Perform general checks of HVAC systems to ensure proper operation.
* Support installation, maintenance, repair, and modification of heating, air-conditioning, refrigeration, and ventilation equipment.
* Perform or support activities such as pipe fitting, brazing, soldering, filter replacement, lubrication, system charging, and minor sheet-metal work, as applicable.
* Repair or replace faulty mechanical components/equipment as required.
* Support pump and gearbox inspection and repair activities.
* Support repair and installation of domestic/split air-conditioning systems.

### **Cleanroom Support**

* Monitor and support maintenance of cleanroom environmental parameters and associated HVAC systems.
* Have basic understanding of cleanroom HVAC validation processes.
* Support filter/HEPA-related maintenance activities and verification as applicable.
* Follow applicable ISO requirements and Micron site standards while working in controlled/cleanroom areas.

### **Breakdown & Troubleshooting**

* Inspect, analyze, and troubleshoot mechanical systems and equipment.
* Perform first-level solving and coordinate with OEM/vendor support where required.
* Respond promptly to mechanical breakdowns and minimize equipment/system downtime.
* Read and interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, schematics, and mechanical layouts.
* Use appropriate hand and power tools safely for mechanical maintenance activities.

### **Project & Contractor Support**

* Support and supervise third-party contractors working on mechanical systems within Micron premises.
* Verify contractor work in the field and ensure activities are carried out according to the approved scope and site requirements.
* Support upcoming mechanical projects such as CDA installation, cleanroom upgrades, HVAC modifications, and other facility improvement projects.
* Support installation, testing, commissioning, punch-point closure, and handover activities for new mechanical systems.
* Coordinate effectively with engineers, contractors, vendors, and other facility fields during maintenance and project activities.

### **Safety, Quality & Documentation**

* Follow all applicable EHS, safety, ISO, and Micron site requirements.
* Follow required safety procedures and work-permit requirements before starting maintenance activities.
* Maintain proper maintenance documentation and equipment history.
* Support QMS requirements applicable to facilities mechanical activities.
* Ensure safe housekeeping practices during and after maintenance work.
* Report equipment abnormalities, safety concerns, and maintenance findings to the responsible Engineer.

**Required Technical Knowledge & Skills**
-----------------------------------------

The candidate should preferably have working knowledge/experience in:

* HVAC and ventilation systems
* Chillers and chilled-water systems
* Air compressors / compressed-air systems
* Vacuum systems
* Pumps and mechanical equipment
* Water systems
* Fire hydrant systems
* Cleanroom HVAC systems and cleanroom parameters
* Preventive and breakdown maintenance
* Mechanical solving
* Reading technical drawings and schematics
* Pipe fitting, brazing and soldering
* Basic pump and gearbox maintenance
* Domestic/split AC installation and maintenance
* Mechanical project and contractor supervision
* Basic SAP PM / computerized maintenance management activities
* Basic QMS and maintenance documentation

**Required Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong mechanical solving and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently inspect and identify equipment abnormalities.
* Ability to understand verbal and written technical instructions.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings, schematics, manuals, and maintenance procedures.
* Ability to communicate technical problems clearly and simply.
* Good communication and active-listening skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Engineers, vendors, contractors, and multi-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize PM, breakdown, operational, and project activities.
* Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Basic understanding of maintenance documentation and reporting.
* Good safety awareness and ability to follow EHS requirements.
* Willingness and ability to work in rotating shifts as per site requirements.
* Partners with key team members to supervise data and continuously improve critical metrics, demonstrating Generative AI insights where applicable.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Previous experience in industrial/manufacturing facilities mechanical maintenance is preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to HVAC, chillers, compressors, pumps, water systems, vacuum systems, and associated facility utilities is preferred.
* Experience supporting cleanroom or controlled-environment facilities would be an advantage.

title: Principal Engineer – Design Verification
description:
**Why join Upscale, Inc.**
--------------------------

Upscale, Inc., is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $500M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world’s most demanding AI workloads.

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking—where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact.

If you’re looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI—Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier—and operate at a high standard.

**We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DV Engineer to anchor the verification of our next-generation, high-performance networking silicon. In this role, you will be the primary technical driver for complex IPs and critical sub-systems. You will balance advanced architectural environment creation with rigorous execution, leading by example on the engineering floor. This position is ideal for a veteran engineer who loves breaking complex designs, building elite UVM environments, and mentoring the next generation of verification talent.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* IP & Sub-system Leadership: Own the complete verification lifecycle for critical high-performance networking IPs and large-scale sub-systems.
* UVM Environment Architecture: Architect, develop, and maintain advanced, scalable constrained-random verification environments from scratch using System Verilog and UVM.
* Test Planning & Execution: Author comprehensive, bulletproof verification plans. Drive test case development, regressions, triage, and coverage closure (functional, code, and assertion-based metrics).
* Advanced Debugging: Serve as the team's go-to expert for isolating and resolving the most complex, deep-seated hardware bugs.
* Lead by Example: Actively participate in design and verification code reviews. Maintain high standards of code quality, reuse, and documentation within the execution team.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Design and Architecture teams to resolve ambiguities early in the design cycle and ensure high-quality delivery.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 15+ years of solid experience in ASIC/SoC Design Verification with a proven track record of successful tape-outs.
* Domain Expertise: Extensive experience in the networking domain, verifying high-throughput, data-intensive designs.
* Methodology Expert: Mastery of System Verilog and UVM. Must have a proven history of writing complex testbenches and VIP integrations from scratch.
* Verification Scope: Proven experience leading verification at the IP and Sub-system level, with strong exposure to SoC integration.
* Education: B Tech/M Tech in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred / Added Advantages**

* Hands-on experience with Formal Property Verification (FPV) to exhaustively verify block-level control logic.
* Proficiency in Python or Perl for testbench automation and triage scripting.

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact—we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent.

**Equal Opportunity**

Upscale, Inc., is building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

**Accessibility & Accommodations**

We’re committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage, just reach out to us at **hiring@upscaleai.com**—we’re happy to help. **Note:** This inbox is only for accommodation requests.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: P6 – Project Head (UAV Systems)
description:
**Department:** UAV / Aerospace Engineering – Project Management  
**Experience:** 6-10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. MBA / PMP / Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Project Head – UAV Systems** to lead and manage the complete development, integration, testing and deployment of advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms.

The candidate must have a strong overall understanding of all major UAV engineering disciplines, including **Propulsion Systems, Airframe & Aerodynamics, Avionics, Quality & Compliance, and Communication & Telemetry**.

The Project Head will be responsible for coordinating all five engineering functions, ensuring that individual subsystems work together as a complete UAV platform.

The role requires a technically strong leader who can understand engineering challenges across departments, review designs, make technical and project-level decisions, manage resources, resolve integration issues and ensure timely project execution.

The candidate should be capable of communicating with engineers, management, vendors, customers and regulatory authorities.

Key Responsibilities1. Overall UAV Project Leadership

* Lead the complete UAV development lifecycle, from concept design to prototype development, testing and deployment.
* Take overall ownership of UAV projects, technical deliverables, timelines, quality and performance.
* Define project scope, technical objectives, milestones and development plans.
* Coordinate and manage all five engineering departments (P1–P5).
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear deliverables for each department.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of engineering activities.
* Conduct regular technical reviews and project review meetings.
* Identify project risks, technical challenges and resource requirements.
* Make critical technical and management decisions to keep projects on track.
* Report project progress, challenges and achievements to senior management.

2. Propulsion Systems – P1

* Understand IC engines, automotive engine adaptation and UAV propulsion requirements.
* Review engine selection, power-to-weight ratio, torque, RPM and fuel-consumption calculations.
* Evaluate engine-to-propeller and engine-to-generator configurations.
* Understand hybrid-electric propulsion architectures.
* Review cooling, lubrication, fuel-delivery and power-transmission systems.
* Evaluate propulsion performance, endurance, reliability and thermal behaviour.
* Coordinate propulsion integration with airframe and electrical systems.
* Review engine test results, dynamometer reports and propulsion validation activities.

3. Airframe & Aerodynamics – P2

* Understand fixed-wing, VTOL and hybrid UAV configurations.
* Review aircraft sizing, MTOW, payload, range, endurance and performance requirements.
* Evaluate wing, fuselage, tail and control-surface designs.
* Understand aerodynamic performance, lift, drag, stability and control.
* Review CFD, FEA and structural analysis reports.
* Evaluate airframe materials, composites, carbon-fibre structures and manufacturing processes.
* Review weight distribution, centre of gravity and structural load calculations.
* Coordinate airframe design with propulsion, avionics and payload requirements.
* Ensure aerodynamic and structural requirements are achieved.

4. Avionics Systems – P3

* Understand complete UAV avionics architecture and system integration.
* Review flight controllers, autopilots, GNSS, IMU and navigation systems.
* Understand PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink and Ground Control Station integration.
* Review sensor integration, actuator interfaces and power-distribution architecture.
* Understand embedded systems, communication protocols and onboard computers.
* Evaluate failsafe systems, redundancy, autonomous flight modes and system health monitoring.
* Coordinate integration of cameras, payloads, mission computers and edge-AI systems.
* Review flight logs, avionics test results and system validation reports.

5. Quality & Compliance – P4

* Establish project-level quality standards and engineering documentation practices.
* Ensure proper requirement management, traceability and configuration control.
* Review PRDs, SRS documents, ICDs, BOMs and engineering change records.
* Ensure design reviews, verification and validation activities are completed.
* Monitor quality processes across design, procurement, manufacturing and testing.
* Review FMEA, risk assessments, NCR, CAPA and root-cause analysis reports.
* Ensure proper inspection, testing and product acceptance procedures.
* Coordinate supplier quality and vendor qualification.
* Oversee product certification and applicable regulatory compliance activities.
* Maintain product documentation and audit readiness.

6. Communication & Telemetry – P5

* Understand UAV command-and-control and telemetry architecture.
* Review RF communication systems, telemetry radios and antenna integration.
* Understand communication link budgets, bandwidth, latency, range and link reliability.
* Evaluate MAVLink, TCP/IP, UDP, CAN, UART and Ethernet interfaces.
* Review primary and backup communication systems.
* Understand LTE/4G/5G, Wi-Fi, mesh networking and long-range RF systems.
* Evaluate antenna placement, signal interference, RSSI, SNR and packet loss.
* Ensure reliable communication between UAV and Ground Control Station.
* Review communication range-test reports and flight-test communication performance.

7. System Integration & Technical Architecture

* Ensure seamless integration of propulsion, airframe, avionics, communication and payload systems.
* Review complete UAV system architecture and subsystem interfaces.
* Identify technical dependencies and integration challenges between departments.
* Ensure compatibility between mechanical, electrical, electronic and software systems.
* Lead system-level design reviews and technical decision-making.
* Establish system-level requirements and interface standards.
* Ensure integration of all subsystems into a functional UAV platform.
* Resolve cross-functional technical conflicts.
* Drive design optimisation for performance, weight, endurance, reliability and cost.

8. Testing, Validation & Flight Operations

* Define the overall testing and validation strategy.
* Oversee subsystem testing, prototype testing and system-level ground testing.
* Coordinate engine, structural, electrical, avionics and communication testing.
* Review ground-test and flight-test plans.
* Ensure proper test procedures, safety checks and acceptance criteria.
* Monitor flight-test results and identify performance gaps.
* Lead root-cause analysis of technical failures.
* Coordinate corrective actions and design improvements.
* Ensure all required validation activities are completed before product release.

9. Project Planning & Resource Management

* Prepare project schedules, budgets and resource-allocation plans.
* Manage engineering teams, vendors, procurement and external development partners.
* Track project milestones, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify delays and implement corrective project plans.
* Manage project risks, technical constraints and budget variations.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of manpower, equipment and resources.
* Coordinate procurement of critical components and long-lead items.
* Maintain project dashboards and management reports.

10. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Lead and mentor department leads and engineering teams.
* Establish accountability and ownership across P1–P5.
* Conduct regular cross-functional coordination meetings.
* Encourage collaboration between mechanical, aerospace, electronics and software teams.
* Communicate project status and technical challenges to management.
* Coordinate with customers to understand mission requirements and expectations.
* Represent the engineering team during customer meetings and technical reviews.
* Manage vendor discussions, technical negotiations and external collaborations.

Required Technical Knowledge

The candidate should have a strong working understanding of:

**Propulsion Systems**

* IC engines and automotive powertrains
* Hybrid-electric propulsion
* Engine-generator systems
* Propellers, thrust and power calculations
* Cooling and fuel systems

**Airframe & Aerodynamics**

* Aircraft design and sizing
* Aerodynamics and flight mechanics
* Structural design and analysis
* Composite materials
* Aircraft stability and control
* Weight and balance

**Avionics**

* Flight controllers and autopilots
* PX4 / ArduPilot
* GNSS, IMU and navigation systems
* Embedded systems
* Sensor integration
* Autonomous flight systems

**Quality & Compliance**

* Product lifecycle management
* Quality Management Systems
* ISO 9001 / AS9100 concepts
* FMEA, CAPA and RCA
* Configuration and change management
* Verification and validation

**Communication & Telemetry**

* RF communication fundamentals
* Telemetry and command-and-control links
* Antenna systems
* Link-budget calculations
* MAVLink and networking protocols
* Communication reliability and redundancy

Preferred Software & Tools

Working knowledge of multiple tools across the following categories is desirable:

* SolidWorks / CATIA / Siemens NX
* ANSYS Mechanical / ANSYS Fluent
* MATLAB / Simulink
* PX4 / ArduPilot
* QGroundControl / Mission Planner
* Python / C / C++
* ROS / ROS 2
* Jira / Confluence
* MS Project / Excel / Power BI
* PLM / PDM / ERP systems

Required Leadership & Management Skills

* Strong technical leadership and decision-making ability.
* Ability to understand and review engineering work across multiple disciplines.
* Excellent project planning and execution skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Cross-functional team management.
* Risk identification and mitigation.
* Vendor and stakeholder management.
* Budget and resource management.
* Technical documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following areas will receive preference:

* UAV / Drone development and manufacturing.
* Fixed-wing, VTOL or hybrid UAV platforms.
* Complete UAV system integration.
* Aerospace or defence product development.
* Hybrid-electric propulsion development.
* Automotive engine adaptation for aircraft applications.
* Flight testing and experimental aircraft development.
* SAE Aero Design / Formula Student / BAJA SAE.
* Aerospace R&D and prototype development.
* Product certification and quality management.
* Leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Project Head will be evaluated on:

* On-time achievement of project milestones.
* Successful integration of all five engineering subsystems.
* Achievement of UAV performance targets (payload, range, endurance and MTOW).
* Technical quality and reliability of the developed UAV.
* Successful completion of ground and flight testing.
* Reduction in integration issues and repeated design failures.
* Adherence to project budgets and resource plans.
* Engineering documentation and compliance readiness.
* Team productivity and cross-functional coordination.
* Successful prototype development and product readiness.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not necessarily expected to personally perform every engineering calculation or CAD activity. However, the candidate must have sufficient technical knowledge and practical experience to understand, review, challenge and guide the work of all five engineering departments.

**The Project Head must be capable of understanding the complete UAV as one integrated system rather than managing five departments independently.**

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Manager - Technical Bid & Solution**
======================================

**Role:**
=========

This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.

**Technical RFP Analysis**
==========================

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

**Solution Shaping**
====================

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

**Estimation & Delivery Planning**
==================================

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

**Technical Proposal Development**
==================================

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

**Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity**
==================================================

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

**Reusable Solution Assets**
============================

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Head of Delivery
description:
- Description

  The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

  You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

  Responsibilities

  **Portfolio and P&L**

  * Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.
  * Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.
  * Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.
  * Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

  **Delivery operating model**

  * Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.
  * Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.
  * Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.
  * Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

  **Client delivery governance**

  * Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.
  * Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.
  * Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

  **Pre-sales support**

  * Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.
  * Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

  **People and leadership**

  * Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.
  * Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.
  * Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

  **Quality and compliance**

  * Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.
  * Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

  Required Skills

  * 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.
  * Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.\
  * Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.
  * Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.
  * Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.
  * Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.
  * Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.
  * Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.
  * Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

  **Nice to have**

  * Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.
  * Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.
  * Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.
  * PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.
  * Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.

title: AI Engineer (Agents & Systems)
description:
**About The Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled and communicative AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications. This is a hybrid role that demands deep technical expertise in modern AI ecosystems alongside exceptional communication skills. You will not only build complex, production\-ready AI systems but also serve as a key technical liaison—translating complex AI concepts for clients, gathering requirements, and producing crystal\-clear technical documentation.

If you are just as comfortable writing complex orchestration logic for LLMs as you are leading a client presentation in flawless English, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Development \& Engineering:**

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent systems, and generative AI applications from scratch.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines tailored to specific business use cases.
* Optimize AI model performance, latency, and cost within production environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise software and workflows.

**Communication \& Client Facing:**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients, leading meetings to gather requirements, scope projects, and present technical solutions clearly and confidently.
* Translate business needs into actionable technical architectures and explain complex AI mechanics to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with internal product managers, developers, and leadership to ensure alignment on project goals.

**Documentation \& Process:**

* Create and maintain comprehensive, high\-quality technical documentation, including system architectures, API specifications, and user manuals.
* Draft clear client proposals, progress reports, and post\-deployment handover documents.
* Establish best practices for code quality, testing, and system documentation within the AI engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Skills:**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Software Engineering with at least 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on, proven experience building and deploying AI applications, LLM integrations, or AI agents in production.
* **Programming:** Advanced proficiency in Python and familiarity with Node.js or TypeScript.
* **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with modern AI orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
* **Models \& APIs:** Deep understanding of commercial and open\-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* **Cloud \& Deployment:** Experience deploying scalable applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, utilizing Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

**Communication \& Soft Skills:**

* **Language:** Exceptional proficiency in written and spoken English. Must be able to articulate complex ideas smoothly and professionally.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** Proven track record of interacting directly with clients, managing expectations, and delivering technical presentations.
* **Documentation:** Strong technical writing skills with a portfolio of past documentation (system designs, readmes, whitepapers, or client briefs).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing personal or open\-source contributions to AI agent frameworks.
* Experience with UI/UX prototyping tools (Streamlit, Gradio, or Next.js) to build quick proof\-of\-concepts for clients.
* Previous experience in a consulting, agency, or fast\-paced startup environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
